mapper.sql: WITH cb AS ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.level, c.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_order b WHERE b.customer_id = c.id) AS order_cnt, GREATEST( COALESCE((SELECT MAX(created_time) FROM biz_order b WHERE b.customer_id = c.id),0), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(created_time) FROM points_record p WHERE p.customer_id = c.id),0), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(created_time) FROM support_ticket t WHERE t.customer_id = c.id),0) ) AS last_active, (SELECT MIN(DATEDIFF(ct.end_date, CURDATE())) FROM customer_contract ct WHERE ct.customer_id = c.id AND ct.status = 'ACTIVE') AS contract_days_left FROM customer c )

CASE WHEN contract_days_left IS NOT NULL AND contract_days_left <= 90 THEN 'RENEW' WHEN last_active = 0 AND order_cnt = 0 THEN 'LEAD' WHEN last_active = 0 OR DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), FROM_UNIXTIME(last_active/1000)) > 180 THEN 'CHURN_RISK' WHEN level IN ('VIP','GOLD') AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), FROM_UNIXTIME(last_active/1000)) <= 30 THEN 'HIGH_VALUE' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), FROM_UNIXTIME(last_active/1000)) <= 30 THEN 'GROWING' ELSE 'STABLE' END
mapper.select: SELECT AS segment, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM cb GROUP BY segment

SELECT id, name, trigger_type AS triggerType, action_type AS actionType, target_item AS targetItem, status, description, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mkt_campaign_exec e WHERE e.campaign_id = m.id) AS execTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mkt_campaign_exec e WHERE e.campaign_id = m.id AND e.created_time >= #{since}) AS execRecent FROM mkt_campaign m ORDER BY m.id
SELECT id, name, trigger_type AS triggerType, action_type AS actionType, target_item AS targetItem, status FROM mkt_campaign WHERE status='ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mkt_campaign_exec WHERE campaign_id=#{campaignId} AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND created_time >= #{since}
SELECT coupon_type, coupon_value FROM points_mall_item WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO points_coupon (id, customer_id, item_id, coupon_code, coupon_type, coupon_value, status, created_time, expire_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{itemId}, #{code}, #{couponType}, #{couponValue}, 'UNUSED', #{createdTime}, #{expireTime})

INSERT INTO mkt_campaign_exec (id, campaign_id, customer_id, action_type, target_item, status, remark, created_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{campaignId}, #{customerId}, #{actionType}, #{targetItem}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdTime})
